_comment: Verified episode titles for shows whose titles are unavailable from Kitsu (null titles) and Jikan (api.jikan.moe unreachable from the build network). Applied LAST by fetch-episode-titles.mjs. Sources noted per entry; titles describe exactly what the Zoko embed streams (by mal_id).

zero-gravity-club._source: Wikipedia: List of Fruits Basket (2019 TV series) episodes — The Final season table (MAL 42938 = Fruits Basket The Final Season; the catalog's 'Blue Lock' comment is wrong, the stream plays Fruits Basket). Retrieved 2026-11-19. Ep 13 'See You Again Soon' (Itte Kimasu, table row 63) added 2026-11-19 when the catalog count was corrected 12 -> 13; Kitsu carries null titles for all 13.

paper-cranes-at-dawn._source: Film (MAL 28851 = A Silent Voice). A movie is listed as one episode titled after the film itself (same convention as MyAnimeList/Jikan).
